name: Mykonos Airport

ppr.v: prior permission (PPR, parking authorisation) is mandatory for all general and business aviation flights; it can be requested up to 14 calendar days before arrival and must be cleared through a licensed ground handler
ppr.quote: PPR Platform users can apply for an Apron clearance within 14 calendar days before the scheduled arrival of the flight.

slots.v: slot-coordinated (IATA Level 3) in summer, not coordinated (Level 1) in winter; the PPR must be obtained from Fraport Greece before the slot request to the Hellenic slot coordinator (HSCA)
slots.quote: JMK Coordinated Airport (IATA Level 3) Non Characterized (IATA Level 1)

handling.v: all PPR requests go through a ground handler holding a category 1 licence; GA/BA flights at JMK also need a ground services confirmation (GSCN)
handling.quote: All PPR requests must be cleared through a Ground Handling Service Provider with a valid category 1 License

hours.v: open every day 00:00 to 23:59, with extensions possible on specific dates
